title: The University of Central Asia Cambridge Scholarship Programme (Academic Year 2027-2028)
about: Scholarship for study at the University of Cambridge in 2027-2028 for candidates from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan, with applicants from Afghanistan, Pakistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan also considered. Shortlisted applicants then submit a full Cambridge application.
